description: Twelve career roadmaps for the engineering skills in demand heading into 2027 — from math foundations and cloud IAM to training LLMs from scratch, agents and harness engineering — with staged projects, time estimates and verified references.
intro: My personal, research-backed study plan for the next few years — published as a living reference. Each track goes Beginner → Intermediate → Advanced → Expert with concepts, projects to build, honest time estimates and readiness signals, and every reference points to an original source.
signalsIntro: Ranked from hiring and survey data published in 2025–2026 (checked November 2026). Links go to the primary report or the publisher's own summary.

skills.evidence: AI engineer is LinkedIn's #1 fastest-growing US role for 2026, with LangChain, RAG and PyTorch as the listed skills. Lightcast (for the 2026 AI Index) finds AI skills in 2.5% of all US postings, up 55% in a year.

sources.label: Dice on LinkedIn Jobs on the Rise 2026

skills.skill: Agentic AI, context and harness engineering
skills.evidence: The "Agentic AI" skill cluster grew from 0.06% to 0.23% of US postings between 2024 and 2025 (≈280%), while plain chatbot skills declined. The vocabulary moved too: *context engineering* (mid-2025) and *harness engineering* (early 2026) are now used by Anthropic and OpenAI.

skills.skill: Working effectively with AI coding agents
skills.evidence: In the 2026 Stack Overflow survey, 66% of AI users use coding agents and most of those use them daily; 79% want to learn more AI skills. GitHub counted over a million agent-authored pull requests in four months of 2025.

Python is the top specialised skill in AI postings (≈259k, up ~30%). TypeScript became GitHub's #1 language in August 2025, and 1.1M+ public repos now use an LLM SDK. SQL rose to #2 in the 2026 Stack Overflow survey.

ISC2's 2025 workforce study ranks AI skills (41%) and cloud security (36%) as the top two skill gaps, and 95% of teams report at least one gap. Identity and least-privilege are the core of cloud security work.
OWASP released a 2026 Top 10 for LLM Applications plus an Agent Control Standard, describing GenAI security as now an operational priority. *Excessive Agency* moved up to #3.

skills.skill: Cloud-native platforms for AI (Kubernetes, model serving)
skills.evidence: 82% of container users run Kubernetes in production, and 66% of organisations hosting generative-AI models use it for inference.
The WEF Future of Jobs 2025 names AI and big data as the fastest-growing skills. 45% of data and analytics postings on Indeed now mention AI, against a 4.2% average across all postings.

Forward-deployed engineer postings in India grew nearly 19× in a year (Indeed data). The role combines building agents with integrating them into a customer's real systems — close to WSO2-style integration work.

skills.skill: Verifying AI output: evals, attribution, cost control
skills.evidence: 93% of developers say source attribution is needed to trust AI output, and 38% of organisations cap AI usage. Being able to measure and verify an AI system is becoming its own skill.

howTo: **Pick one lane, keep one foundation.** Run one main track plus Foundations or Software Engineering in parallel. Don't run five at once.
**Build in public.** Every stage ends in a project. Write it up as a [blog post](/blog/) that links back here.

**Junior caveat:** the 2026 AI Index reports employment of developers aged 22–25 fell ~20% since 2024. Depth plus shipped projects beats breadth. [Source](https://hai.stanford.edu/news/inside-the-ai-index-12-takeaways-from-the-2026-report)
**Times are focused hours** (reading plus building). Set your weekly hours at the top and every estimate updates.
**Tick items as you go.** Progress is saved in this browser only, and nothing is sent anywhere.
